protocolDosing.notes: popular co-administered healing stack: BPC-157 (~250–500 mcg/day) + TB-500 (~2–5 mg/week). Blend note referencing both; no validated human dosing

mechanismOfAction.summary: Co-administered tissue-repair stack (BPC-157 + Thymosin β4 fragment).
mechanismOfAction.description: Combination of the pentadecapeptide BPC-157 and the Thymosin β4 fragment TB-500, commonly stacked for soft-tissue and connective-tissue repair. Effects derive from each component's individual healing/angiogenic activity.
